# The identifier list of the session review ledger, mirrored INTO the crate.
#
# The ledger itself is a working document of the project and is not part of
# the public export; only these identifiers are, so that the link between a
# corpus case and the divergence it was written for survives the export and
# can be checked by a test instead of by prose.
#
# Two sections. [corpus-backed] identifiers name a divergence a verifier can
# get WRONG at run time, so each of them MUST be carried by at least one
# corpus case (`# gap: <id>` in the case's expected.txt).  [text pins]
# identifiers name a gap the specification closed with a sentence that no
# package can exercise -- a CLI shape, a stream, an exit code the corpus
# cannot reach, an appendix -- so they need no case.
#
# `intent_spec_gaps_have_cases.rs` enforces both directions: no corpus case
# may carry an identifier missing from this file, and no identifier whose
# family is corpus-testable may be listed without a case.
#
# Added by fix-pack R3: SPEC-GAP-4.1-date-2 (signed year) and
# SPEC-GAP-4.1-datetime-3 (colon-less +HHMM offset).
# SPEC-GAP-4.1-string was introduced by fix-pack R1 with the String paragraph.
